# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 54 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_054_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 54

**1** Jesus said: "Blessed are the poor, for yours is the kingdom of heaven."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- The unqualified beatitude; no "in spirit" qualification
- The second person pronoun "yours" is remarkable: the poor are directly addressed; the kingdom belongs to them now
- "Kingdom of heaven" — the full title; rare in Thomas (cf. Sayings 20, 54)

---
